steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Ahead is our destination, <color=#fb9259>the inner bay</color> on the southwest shore of DisSea, the center of the former West District mining belt.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: During the great explosion of DisSea, the inner bay mining area was completely destroyed, and the coast became extremely uninhabitable due to the spreading mental contamination.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Only civilians who don't want to join the gangs will be forced to settle here. They call this place the <color=#fb9259>Drifter Camp</color>. It was once seen as the slum of the Syndicate.
...They call this a slum?

The car climbs over the slope, and the view opens up. On both sides, shanty towers stretch forward, but at the end lies a colossal structure. Rusted brackets and staggered iron frames make up the most amazing fortress in the Syndicate.
The structure is more than 100 meters high, crowded and skewed, unreasonably unstable but resolutely standing. It's magnificent and full of life, like a steel beast that will leap up the next second.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: WOW! Woah!!! When did Syndicate get something so awesome?!! Why have I never seen this before?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Oh, of course you haven't. Not long ago, this place was just an ordinary deserted building. The poor drifters paid extortion to the gangs for so many years and couldn't do anything to help themselves.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Only after the fall of the gangs was the Drifter Camp freed. They've been buttoned down for too long, and once the oppressors are gone, they're growing like weeds.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You said Parma has been here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are they working together on this? Is the Drifter Camp messing with Mania too? Do they have anything to do with BR-004?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Slow down, Chief. I did see traces of Parma here, but so far, I don't think they are working together.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: On the contrary, because of their disgust for the gangs and the chaos, weapons, and contamination they bring, the Drifter Camp is rather hostile to everything related to Mania.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: They stockpiled Hypercube and built their own anti-Mania equipment to protect the residents. Even when the gangs raged with Mania not long ago, this place was clear from contamination.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Resisting Mania contamination without the support of FAC... Not just any ordinary drifters can do that.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Yes, I've been monitoring the Drifter Camp for some time now, and there are indeed great talents here, as well as information that we have trouble getting our hands on.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: It would be nice if we could work with them.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Yes, if it were half a year earlier, you would have been able to get help from the Drifter Camp. But now... the situation is tricky.
You can imagine why. You look at the executive officer sitting across from you in a gray and yellow uniform.

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: Do you have to come with us?
options: Do you have to come with us?

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: That's right. The Drifter Camp is home to a large number of West District outlaws. Since there are now signs of Mania there, and a relapse of BR-004 is involved, we can't complete the reconstruction without looking into this.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: The West District is a complicated area, and you need our authority to ensure personal safety and a smooth investigation.

<size=30>After the outbreak of BR-004, the enforcement of West District Order Management Regulations was suspended, the local security precinct was withdrawn, and the Reconstruction Committee, led by the city council, assumed the district administrative functions.</size>

It's said to be multi-funded, diversified and open, crossing the Rust to the West District in order to cover the economic, medical, educational, and public administration fields, seeking to fix the chaos and help Syndicate get back on track.
...The help, however, now seems like a joke.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I was hoping it would be a friendly discussion.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: That's unrealistic thinking. Drifter Camp has built illegal constructions and has been arming themselves. They have defied management by stealing Hypercubes. And recently, we have seen them having more friction with the leftover gangsters.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Those people are selfish, short-sighted, and ungrateful. They are already a serious threat to the new order in the West District and must be strictly monitored.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: The West District can't afford another riot like the Legion had, and it's important to take preventive measures.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm on a very important Mania investigation mission. If we make a big deal out of this and more serious contamination breaks out, can you and your Reconstruction Executive Committee be held accountable?

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: That is within your authority and responsibility. We assist but do not interfere.
But he has no intention of leaving either.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: So this is the situation. The sheriffs haven't cleaned up their mess, and the execs are acting too aggressively. Now, the entire Drifter Camp lacks trust in the DisCity authorities.
[Flashback to the 9-1 poacher]
You did get a glimpse of their tactics. Even the FAC couldn't look away, and the locals must be more disgusted. You're kind of getting caught in the crossfire.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Time is ticking. Need to be flexible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: West District management is not what I should worry about. The primary goal is to get into Drifter Camp and look for clues about Parma, who is likely to carry a Corpus-level contamination source.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There must be some connection between the two, and I need to gather as much information as possible.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You won't be welcome with that uniform, and I can't guarantee what you'll encounter. Chief, are you mentally prepared?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course. With you, the undercover agent, and the "insurance measure," how bad could it be?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Hehe, I'd rather not reveal my identity so early. If you encounter any problem, please consider using your personal charm to solve it first.

steps.speaker: T04dRati0s: Ha, if they can make a killer fog outta this sand pit, that'll be a real urban legend. Legend Hunter R.C. [OP]: Ooooh a new urban legend!! Bring it on!! T04dRati0s: Bring on my ass...
steps.content: The worst case scenario...
You roll your eyes and are about to say something when a violent explosion suddenly rocks the ground, stopping the car in its track.

Almost simultaneously, a young man in a cloak suddenly leaps out of the alleyway, hits the front of the car, and rolls to the side. Immediately thereafter, you hear a familiar gruff growl from the rear.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: It's gangsters. Confirm, there is a conflict between Drifter Camp and gangsters. Reporting it immediately and requesting backup.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Request to enter Drifter Camp to investigate, repeat...
Before you can get out of the car to help, the young man stumbles to his feet and limps away into the misshapen narrow alleys of the slums without looking at you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, what should I do?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's deal with the gangsters first.

steps.content: So, is this some kind of trouble or an opportunity that can be seized?
